answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow accrual: each agent identity must lock a refundable deposit and earn trust only through verifiable completed work over time, like a lotus that opens gradually rather than all at once. A newcomer starts on a small knoll of low limits, with tiny transaction caps and no voting weight, and climbs toward the zenith only after sustained honest behavior. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits plus weeks of work, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its standing.
